articles.title: ISRO detects possible subsurface ice on moon using Chandrayaan-2 data
articles.summary: Indian scientists from Ahmedabad's Physical Research Laboratory, using data from Chandrayaan-2, have identified strong evidence of subsurface ice in extremely cold craters near the Moon's south pole. This significant discovery deepens our understanding of lunar water resources, which are vital for future space missions and potential human habitation on the Moon, underscoring India's advancements in space exploration.

articles.title: India invites bids from 3 private players for advanced stealth fighter project
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has issued the Request for Proposal (RFP) for India's indigenous fifth-generation Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) project to three private bidders. This crucial move significantly advances India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing, aiming to develop a cutting-edge fighter jet. It strengthens the 'Make in India' initiative, enhancing the Indian Air Force's future combat capabilities and strategic readiness.

articles.title: German submarine bid promises Canada $86B economic boost and tens of thousands of jobs
articles.summary: Canada is reportedly considering purchasing German-made Type 212CD submarines. This significant defence acquisition could generate up to 50,000 jobs domestically over the next five years. The potential deal underscores how strategic military procurements can offer substantial national economic benefits and industrial growth, alongside modernizing naval capabilities, providing a dual advantage for national security and prosperity.

articles.title: Corporations can vote in some Delaware elections, judge says
articles.summary: A Delaware judge issued a novel ruling granting artificial entities, such as corporations, partnerships, and LLCs, the right to vote in state elections under specific circumstances. This unprecedented decision expands voting rights beyond individuals, potentially allowing business interests to directly influence local governance. The ruling sparks debate on corporate personhood and its implications for democratic processes within Delaware's legal framework.

articles.title: China issues new rules to keep senior military officials in check
articles.summary: China has implemented new discipline measures for its top military officials, according to state media reports. This move is part of President Xi Jinping's prolonged campaign to purge corruption within the People's Liberation Army. The initiative underscores Beijing's commitment to strengthening party control and ensuring accountability among high-ranking military personnel, aiming to enhance the overall discipline and effectiveness of its armed forces.

articles.title: Northisle Announces Board Slate for 2026 AGM
articles.summary: Northisle Copper and Gold Inc., a Vancouver-based firm, has announced its proposed slate of directors for the 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM). This corporate governance development is crucial for the company's future strategic direction and operational oversight within the mining sector. Such board compositions are vital for investor confidence and effective resource management, reflecting key aspects of business leadership.

articles.title: NEET leak: Delhi court remands kingpin Prahlad Vithalrao Kulkarni to 14 days' judicial custody
articles.summary: A Delhi court sent alleged kingpin Prahlad Vithalrao Kulkarni and Shivraj Raghunath to 14-day judicial custody in the NEET paper leak case. This development underscores serious concerns about examination integrity, impacting lakhs of aspirants nationwide. Such incidents highlight the need for robust mechanisms to safeguard the fairness and credibility of competitive examinations, crucial for national talent selection.

articles.title: Tacconelli’s Just Built the Ultimate Cocktail Oasis
articles.summary: A renowned 'pizza legend' has expanded into the hospitality sector, inaugurating 'Bar Tacconelli', a sophisticated new cocktail bar. Located in a New Jersey strip mall, the establishment focuses on a sleek, martini-centric experience. This venture marks a significant diversification for the popular food brand, bringing its established reputation for excellence into the burgeoning world of craft beverages and upscale bar offerings, aiming to attract a broader clientele.
